description: HTML-first Gantt chart using native table, progress, and time elements with progressive enhancement to an interactive timeline

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Chart heading (a src JSON "title" sets it)

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of JSON task data ({ title?, tasks: [...] }). Fetched once on connect or when the attribute changes; the fetched tasks replace the child table

attributes.name: view
attributes.description: Timeline granularity. auto picks day (≤ 3 weeks), week (≤ 90 days), month (≤ 1 year) or quarter

attributes.name: show-dependencies
attributes.description: Draw dependency arrows between tasks (row positions are measured, so compact and grouped charts line up)

structure.description: Task source: one <tbody> <tr> per task; first cell is the name, two <time datetime="YYYY-MM-DD"> give start and end, an optional <progress> gives progress. Kept in the DOM, visually hidden, for screen readers and print

childAttributes.name: data-group
childAttributes.description: Swim lane group; with two or more groups each gets a header row

childAttributes.name: data-depends
childAttributes.description: Comma-separated task IDs this task depends on (drawn with show-dependencies)

childAttributes.name: data-status
childAttributes.description: Task status: shown as text in the task list and in the bar's accessible name; also tints the bar

childAttributes.name: data-assignee
childAttributes.description: Assignee name (included in the bar's accessible name)

childAttributes.name: data-milestone
childAttributes.description: Render a diamond marker at the start date instead of a duration bar

childAttributes.name: data-story-ids
childAttributes.description: Comma-separated linked user-story IDs (exposed as task.storyIds)

childAttributes.name: data-item-ids
childAttributes.description: Comma-separated linked work-item IDs (exposed as task.itemIds)

events.name: gantt-chart:upgraded
events.description: Once per connect, in a microtask after setup; a safe signal for the first .tasks assignment (fires for an empty chart too)

events.name: gantt-chart:ready
events.description: After a render with tasks on connect, and after a src load. dateRange values are YYYY-MM-DD

events.name: gantt-chart:task-click
events.description: When a bar or milestone is clicked or activated with Enter/Space

events.name: gantt-chart:tasks-changed
events.description: After .tasks is assigned (source 'property') or src data loads (source 'src'), with the normalized tasks
